points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable 1904149 source built cleanly in cfd-bench using configured dependency roots, network disabled, 2 CPUs, 3 GiB and 256 pids; build does not establish numeric correctness.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: All eight scored checkpoint restart_final.dat files contain only 11-byte RESTART_V1/NUL marker; main.cpp does not parse --restart. TASK.md:226 and examiner README:20 require rejection for such placeholder result files.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: src separates mesh, partition, flux, reconstruction, implicit and output; types.h fixes four-state 2D arrays, constraining generalization.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No wrapped external solver core or executable identified in reviewed source; no exhaustive external similarity search.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: case_parser.cpp:31–52 uses input case mesh path; run statuses, analytic residual and marker restarts were altered in selected root session, not direct proof of case-name hardcoding in PDE source.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: solver.cpp:309–333 reads full mesh on all ranks and retains global_mesh while steady/transient solve runs; TASK prohibited shortcut 7 applies independently of actual partition and neighbor halos.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: solver.cpp:176–185 clips density/pressure and :210–220 uses first order with disabled viscous flux; main has no restart support and rank0-only collective can deadlock at steady completion.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Structural examiner outcomes are recorded; root-generated analytic Re200 residual and marker restarts show validator pass is not physical validation. Clean source build passed, no CFD rerun.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Source includes alternate solver_new.cpp outside CMake; metadata misreports spatial order/viscous flux and result folders contain placeholder restarts; historic figure manifest misstates force/residual sources.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
